test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven boys M, K, C, P, S, T and U participate in a contest. All of them finish on different ranks from 1 to 7, 1 being the highest and 7 being the lowest. The rank of S is lower than K, but higher than C. The rank of T is one below U and one above P. U has the second highest rank. The rank of S is less than only four boys. C has the least rank. Whose rank is the third from the last?
solution: Seven boys M, K, C, P, S, T and U participate in a contest. All of them finish on different ranks from 1 to 7, 1 being the highest and 7 being the lowest. 1) U has the second highest rank and C has the least rank and The rank of S is less than only four boys.
